content: Healthcare scheduling sources, including Deputy healthcare blog, Vars Health, Healthcarousel: the critical failure mode named repeatedly is credential tracking living in a system SEPARATE from the scheduler, so an expired license or BLS cert does not block a shift assignment until an audit or incident catches it after the fact. The described best-practice fix is credential-aware scheduling where an expired or missing credential blocks the assignment automatically at scheduling time, a hard block, not a downstream compliance check. This directly supports a hard-block, no-override design for qualifications, but shows most competitors do not implement it this way by default; it is treated as an advanced or healthcare-vertical feature, not baseline.
